explanation_emblems_and_dungeons: Display an emblem or a dungeon for your game. Planeswalker emblems and dungeons are game elements that add special rules or conditions to your Magic game. You can search any emblem or dungeon from Scryfall, or choose from a few common emblems:
emblem_ring_preset: The Ring / The Ring Tempts You
emblem_search_noresult: No emblem/dungeon found for this query.
emblem_dungeon_drag_hint: Long-press a marker, then drag it anywhere on the dungeon image. If it has never been moved, it already starts at a default slot. The position is saved per player and per dungeon.
emblem_no_image: No image available for this emblem.
vanguard_mode_enabled: Enable Vanguard mode on new game
treachery_mode_enabled: Enable Treachery mode on new game
vanguard_draft_three: Variant: 3 Vanguard cards then keep one
vanguard_explanation: Vanguard cards are optional role cards that change starting life, hand size, and grant static abilities. In Vanguard mode, each player gets a random Vanguard (uniform, without replacement).
treachery_explanation: In Treachery mode, each player secretly gets a random identity (Leader, Traitor, Assassin, Guardian) based on player count. Each role can be viewed once, then remains hidden.
treachery_official_link: Website with the rules for the Treachery mode (not official WotC)
shogun_nonofficial_link: Website with the rules for the Shogun mode (not official WotC)
vanguard_wiki_link: Read Vanguard rules on MTG Wiki
vanguard_random_rule: Random assignment is uniform and without replacement.
treachery_random_rule: Role distribution: 4 P = 1 Leader, 1 Traitor, 2 Assassins; 5 P = +1 Guardian; 6 P = +1 Assassin +1 Guardian.
shogun_explanation: Shogun variant is a simpler hidden-role mode: each player secretly gets a role (Shogun, Traitor, Assassin, Guardian) based on player count. Roles can be viewed once, then stay hidden.
treachery_hide_after_reading: Close this view after reading: the identity stays hidden after that.

bounty_explanation: Bounty mode is a casual Commander variant from Outlaws of Thunder Junction. Shuffle at least 6 unique Bounty cards face-down. Starting on the third turn, reveal one each turn. Claim it during your turn for a reward!
bounty_wiki_link: Read Bounty rules on MTG Wiki
bounty_start_hint: Load the 12 Bounty cards from Scryfall and start the game.
bounty_load_error: Failed to load Bounty cards from Scryfall. Check your connection.
bounty_reward_3: Create two Treasure tokens OR draw a card.
bounty_reward_4: (MAX) Create two Treasure tokens AND draw a card.
bounty_rules_1: Before the game, shuffle at least 6 unique Bounty cards into a face-down pile.
bounty_rules_2: As the starting player's third turn begins, reveal the top Bounty card.
bounty_rules_3: Claim the revealed Bounty during your turn and collect your reward! Then reveal the next one and reset the reward level.
bounty_rules_4: If nobody claims the Bounty before the turn comes back to you, increase its reward to the next level (up to level 4). When the pile is empty, reshuffle all claimed Bounties.
bounty_show_back_image: Show the official Bounty card back image
planechase_menu_explanation: Planechase (Planar Magic) is an optional multiplayer format where players travel through a shared planar deck. Plane and Phenomenon cards add unique rules to each game.
planechase_search_noresult: No Plane or Phenomenon card found.
planechase_no_deck: No planar deck loaded. Go back to the Planechase menu to load one.
planechase_no_image: No image available for this card.
planechase_die_planeswalk: Planeswalk! Move to the next plane.
planechase_die_chaos: Chaos! Trigger the Chaos ability of the current plane.
planechase_planeswalk_hint: The top card of the planar deck has been revealed as the new plane.
planechase_rules_summary:
• All players share a single planar deck (shuffled together).
• At the start, reveal the top card — that is the active plane.
• On your turn you may roll the planar die (🎲):
  – Blank (4/6): nothing happens.
  – Planeswalk (1/6): move to the next plane.
  – Chaos (1/6): trigger the Chaos ability on the current plane.
• Phenomenon cards trigger immediately when revealed, then you planeswalk again.
• You may pay {1} for each extra roll on the same turn.
archenemy_menu_explanation: Archenemy is an optional multiplayer format where one player (the Archenemy) faces a team of opponents and uses a scheme deck to gain powerful advantages each turn.
archenemy_no_deck: No scheme deck loaded. Go back to the Archenemy menu to load one.
archenemy_no_image: No image available for this card.
archenemy_ongoing_badge: Ongoing Scheme — stays in play until abandoned.
archenemy_rules_summary:
• One player is the Archenemy; the rest form a team.
• The Archenemy starts with 40 life; all others start with 20.
• At the start of the Archenemy's turn, they set the top card of their scheme deck in motion.
• Normal (non-ongoing) schemes trigger immediately, then are set aside.
• Ongoing schemes remain in play until their abandon condition is met.
• The team takes turns in a clockwise order and acts together to defeat the Archenemy.
